title: Define file token, static asset, and scoped download service boundaries
description: AstrBot dashboard serves file-token downloads and dashboard static assets through dedicated routes. Rust has WebChat attachment ports and path/temp tasks, but still needs a scoped download/static asset boundary before dashboard files, plugin logos, backups, and OpenAPI file uploads expand.

files.change: Map opaque download tokens to scoped file records outside web handlers.
Serve dashboard/plugin/backup files through typed token checks rather than raw paths.
Separate bundled/user-provided dashboard asset path selection from HTTP route code.

criteria: HTTP routes never accept unchecked filesystem paths.
Dashboard static asset selection is runtime policy, not route logic.
File-token access can be tested through storage ports.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
